narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Forty one tenths has the bigger number, so it is longer than four and one tenth.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>But four and one tenth is forty tenths and one more tenth.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>That is forty one tenths, the same count.
